method: the stated step is classified from the configuration (central angle vs inscribed angle on the major arc; two inscribed angles on the same side of a chord; diameter; opposite vertices of a cyclic quadrilateral; perpendicular from the centre; equal chords) with the numeric step verified (x2, equal, 90 and complement, 180 - x, doubling the half-chord, equal distances); an option justifies the step iff it names that theorem. The two supplementary-looking false statements are false statements, never correct
assumptions: Textbook statements: central angle theorem, angles in the same segment, Thales, cyclic quadrilateral, perpendicular from the centre bisects the chord, equal chords are equidistant (NCERT class 9 ch.10).
